title: Discharge summary - chest pain
text: Patient was admitted with chest pain and ruled out for myocardial infarction. Troponin levels remained normal across three draws. Discharged on low-dose aspirin and a statin with cardiology follow-up in two weeks. Patient advised to avoid strenuous exercise until stress test results are reviewed. Questions can be sent to cardio.desk@acme-health.example.

title: Diabetes management plan
text: HbA1c of 8.2 percent indicates suboptimal glycemic control. Metformin dose increased to 1000 mg twice daily. Dietitian referral placed for carbohydrate counting education. Recheck HbA1c in three months.

title: Well-child visit 18 months
text: Well-child visit at 18 months. Growth tracking along the 60th percentile for height and weight. Immunizations administered per schedule including MMR and varicella boosters. Parents counseled on toddler sleep routines and car seat safety.

title: Echocardiogram report
text: Echocardiogram shows ejection fraction of 40 percent consistent with mild systolic dysfunction. Started on an ACE inhibitor and a beta blocker. Sodium restricted diet recommended. Enrolled in the heart failure clinic for monitoring.
